 "_about": "Shared by tests/test_series_planner.py (aggregate_quote) and command-center/tests/seriesQuote.test.ts (aggregateSeriesQuote): the two aggregations must agree. credits null = unpriced, with the named gap. total is null if ANY episode is null; partial is the sum of the priced ones only. A credits value that is not a number from 0 to 1e12 (NaN, Infinity, negative, a string, a boolean, too large) is invalid_estimate in both languages; the strings 'NaN', 'Infinity' and '-Infinity' stand for those float values because JSON cannot carry them. A case may carry 'durations' (one per duration entry, default 300 per credits entry): when the two lists differ in length the unpaired entries are unpriced episodes with the gap count_mismatch in both languages (no entry is silently dropped), and the result is never complete.",
